expectations.buyer: Controls engineers, OT architects, system integrators, plant IT, distributors, and machine or line builders
expectations.pain: A protocol gateway matches labels on paper but fails on data types, timing, security, redundancy, diagnostics, certification, or vendor-specific device behavior
expectations.strongestIncumbent: Vendor product selectors, distributors, Kepware and OPC ecosystems, industrial-network consultants, proof-of-concept benches, and device certification lists
expectations.biggestRisk: Selectors and distributors absorb discovery, the compatibility matrix is vendor-maintained, and a neutral resolver cannot warrant real-time or safety behavior without tests
